sources.title: fastino/GLiNER2.5-multi-Decide · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The multilingual classification model in the GLiNER2.5 family. One checkpoint, any label set you pass at call time: intent, routing, sentiment, priority, policy, and multi-label tags, in a single forward pass.

sources.title: GLiNER2.5: Open-Source Information Extraction Model - fastino.ai
sources.snippet: GLiNER2.5 is an open-source model for schema-driven information extraction, including efficient entity and relation extraction with no fixed span-length limit.

sources.title: GLiNER2.5 Models - a fastino Collection - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: Fastino Labs
sources.snippet: Fastino Labs builds open language models for agentic AI, including GLiNER, GLiGuard, and the Fastino fine-tuning agent. See our research and models.

sources.title: GLiNER2.5-Decide: 340M Open Model Beats Jev on Routing - explainx.ai
sources.snippet: Fastino released GLiNER2.5-Decide, a 340M Apache 2.0 encoder for typed classification and rules. Benchmarks vs Jev, latency on CPU, and when to use it.
